# Examples

Examples show individual API operations. For complete workflows, see
[Tutorials](../tutorials/index.qmd). Start with the
[Simple Example](intro/simple.qmd).

## Background & Distances

- [Dark Energy WSpline](intro/wspline.qmd) --- a spline-reconstructed dark-energy equation of state.
- [Recombination](intro/recombination.qmd) --- computing the ionization and visibility history.

## Large-Scale Structure

- [Matter Power Spectrum](intro/power_spectrum.qmd) --- linear and nonlinear power spectra.
- [Halo Mass Function](intro/halo_mass_function.qmd) --- halo abundance from the filtered power spectrum.

## Primordial

- [Primordial Modeling](intro/hiprim.qmd) --- implementing a primordial cosmology model.
- [Primordial Tensor Contribution](intro/hiprim_tensor.qmd) --- testing tensor modes.

## Data & Statistics

- [SN Ia Fitting](data_analysis/snia.qmd) --- fitting a Type Ia supernova sample.
- [SNIa + BAO Confidence Regions](data_analysis/rg_snia_bao.qmd) --- comparing likelihood-ratio and Fisher confidence regions.
- [Inspect Data Objects](data_analysis/inspect_data_objects.qmd) --- exploring NumCosmo data objects.
- [Empirical PDF](intro/epdf.qmd) --- building an empirical distribution.
